notes.title: A capsule came back
notes.content: The time has finally come. The popular capsule from Capsule Jump has returned in the sequel game “Takki Jump”. Here you can experience the story of this little Takki. Take a look and complete the latest jumping challenges in the body of a capsule.

notes.title: A capsule is coming back
notes.content: Yeah it's true what you read. A capsule is coming back, but with a whole new design, themed worlds and even a story. What was once just a game that focused on difficulty now has a successor, with its own story, themed levels and a difficulty level that doesn't stand in the way of its predecessor. It's coming soon, so put it on your wish list, the new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160850/Takki_Jump/]Takki Jump[/url]

notes.title: Adding Restart Button
notes.content: Adding the "R" Button to restart a level, to optimize Speedruns

notes.title: Leaderboards now save the score since level load and not since game load
notes.content: Leaderboards now save the score since level load and not since game load

notes.title: Adding Leaderboards
notes.content:
Now you can compare with other Capsule Jump Players in the leaderboards. Who will be the fastest in the levels?

Additionally there was a bug with the fullscreen mode, when you go into options menu, this bug is fixed now

notes.title: Change Languages
notes.content: You have now the ability to swap language between english and german

notes.title: Options Update
notes.content: There is now a new options menu on title screen, where you can change the sound volume, the screen resolution and switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Little Update
notes.content: In Main Menu there is now an option to change the volume of the capsule sound and of the music

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Long time nothing happened to capsule jump, but right now I decided to update this game and add quality of life content.

1. In all standard levels you can now open a menu when pressing on escape button, where you can restart the level, go back to level menu or just quit the application
2. If you now complete a level it will be always highlighted in level select.

I am always happy about improvement ideas.

So happy jumping to yall, don't tilt, and be ready for upcoming update

notes.title: Capsule Jump becomes Free-to-Play
notes.content: After now a few years of the game on Steam and a few years without an update, I would like to announce that Capsule Jump will be converted to a free version. When exactly it will be so far, I can not say exactly, hopefully this is through until the end of April. I thank all who still bought the game and wish all new players a lot of fun with Capsule Jump.
